cards.text: This is a Shiggaion that David, king of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3), sang to the LORD about the words of Cush, a Benjamite. David opens with, "O LORD my God, I take refuge in You…" Then he asks the LORD to save him and deliver him from all his pursuers.

cards.question: David asks the LORD to save him, or his pursuers will shred his soul like a lion. What else does David say they'll do?
True or false: David says someone will be there to rescue him from his pursuers.

cards.text: Then David puts himself on trial: "…if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands…" That's like telling your boss, "Go ahead, PULL the security footage."

cards.question: David keeps going with his if-I-did-it list. True or false: one item on it is rewarding his ally with evil.
David says that if he really has done these things, what should happen to him?

answers.text: Let his enemy trample him down
Let the LORD forgive him anyway
Let the elders settle the matter

cards.text: Then David calls out: "Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies."

cards.question: With his enemies in a fury, David cries, "Awake, my God…" and asks Him to do what?

cards.text: Then David asks for the assembled peoples to gather around the LORD, and for the LORD to take His seat over them on high. That is a LOT of folding chairs.

cards.question: David says, "The LORD judges the peoples…" Then he asks the LORD to vindicate him. True or false: he asks for it according to his royal rank.

cards.text: David asks God to put an end to the evil of the wicked and establish the righteous. Down here, somebody can send a thumbs-up in the group chat while they're FUMING on the other end of that phone, but that doesn't work with God.

cards.question: What does David say the righteous God searches?

cards.text: Next, David tells us where his protection is. Friend, when the pressure is on, you find out FAST who's really got your back.

cards.question: David says his shield is with ___, who saves the upright in heart.
David says God is righteous. True or false: he also says God feels indignation only once in a while.

cards.text: Then the picture turns sharp: God will sharpen His sword. He has bent and strung His bow, prepared His deadly weapons, and He ordains His arrows with fire.

cards.question: David says God will sharpen His sword. In what case?

cards.text: Now David turns the spotlight on the wicked man, and he uses a picture of pregnancy: the man travails with evil and conceives trouble. That one's been on the way for a WHILE, friend, and nobody is throwing it a shower.

cards.question: In David's picture, the wicked man conceives trouble. What happens to it?

cards.text: The wicked man digs a hole and hollows it out. I bet he's PROUD of that hole.

cards.question: True or false: the wicked man ends up falling into the hole he dug.

cards.text: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head. Friend, I spent YEARS stuck in a junk drawer I didn't even build, and this man DUG his!
After the sword, the arrows and the pit, David turns to the LORD with praise. He says he will "…sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High."

cards.question: David also says he will thank the LORD for His ___.
